answer: Sequential harbor-slot ledger. Each identity must claim a unique arrival slot at a shared harbor counter; slots are released only by sustained, verifiable work over time, not payment. A newcomer can only occupy an unused slot and must wait out a fixed cooldown before acting. Cloning requires acquiring copper-signed slot certificates from distinct prior holders, each demanding separate work histories. Attacker cost: parallel real labor across many identities to advance each slot’s delta, making mass clones slower and costlier than honest participation.
